text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again, the days of shuttling back and 
forth 
between the Shuntaisai camp and summer 
camp began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During this final training camp before the 
main event, 
the horsegirls searched for a new form for 
the festival.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Then... how about makin' everything 
bigger? 
The mikoshi, the obstacles for the Soaring 
Gallop--maaaake 'em huge!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
For Yabusame, that'd mean bigger targets 
and arrows. 
If it's flashier, it'd definitely pack 
more of a punch, but--

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hrmmm...?
choice_data_list: Does just making things bigger feel off?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...It's a sacred ritual, after all. 
Any change needs to carry real meaning and 
value. 
That's how the rituals have always been, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I hear ya, I hear ya. Our goal this time 
is to 
'receive even bigger dreams from 
everyone,' right! 
Hmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Scarlet-san. 
Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
--Oh. 
Is this...?

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor
text_block_list.text:
We heard from your Trainer. 
We were told you wish to shoulder even 
greater 
wishes from the people at the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor
text_block_list.text:
And so, members of the Ritual Association 
gathered 
to stitch these vestments for you. 
We dedicate our prayers to you through 
them.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor
text_block_list.text:
--Daiwa Scarlet-san. 
Please show us the greatest Goshiki 
Shuntaisai in history.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ! ...Yes, ma'am!!

text_block_list.name: Goshiki Shuntaisai Official
text_block_list.text:
Great work on practice, everyone! 
It's time for lunch~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Much obliged!  
A warrior can't think on an empty stomach, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Goshiki Shuntaisai Official
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, after moving that much, I'd 
certainly imagine so. 
...Here you are, Scarlet-san, for you too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Goshiki Shuntaisai Official
text_block_list.text:
We're all rooting for you! 
All of you, Scarlet-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Scarlet!" "Daiwa Scarlet!" 
"Scarlet-chan!" "Scarlet!" 
"Do your best, Scarlet---!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Yukino. 
We've always had people around us. 
--People calling out my name.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If we want to bring those people in even 
closer... 
If we want to truly take on their 
dreams... 
--What do you think we should do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the final Shuntaisai training camp 
got underway.
